prompts.prompt: When several endpoint filters are chained on one ASP.NET Core Minimal API route, what execution order do they follow going into the handler versus coming back out after it? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/aspnet-minimal-apis/SKILL.md - Execution order: FIFO before handler, FILO after handler (like middleware).
